lines 248, 256 and 263, function skeleton_drop_few_items: an_spawn_item heap allocation per drop

notes: Not found in this file: dropRareDrop (the wither skeleton skull), onDeath's snipeSkeleton achievement, the Halloween pumpkin helmet in onSpawnWithEgg (a Calendar read; spawning.c has its own halloween calendar fields), updateRidden's yaw copy for spider jockeys, and getYOffset. Difficulty is hardcoded Normal (diff_id 2) in the arrow inaccuracy and damage. Evidence recordings: out/java/hostiles sk-2, sk-42 and the fight-skeleton-s1 snapshot.
